# TwelveCheck

TwelveCheck is a fixed-scope, human public-build launch review for SaaS founders launching within 72 hours.

## Offer

- Price: USD 89 total commission.
- Turnaround: within 12 hours after scope acceptance.
- Deliverables: twelve normal-user checks, timestamped evidence, P0/P1/P2 issue list, short walkthrough, and one scoped revision.
- Inputs: a public URL, planned launch time, and three critical public journeys.
- Exclusions: security testing, penetration testing, load testing, privileged access, certification, legal or compliance review, and guarantees.
- Payment: no payment is due until the public scope is accepted.

## Public resources

- Offer: https://mshafei721.github.io/twelvecheck/
- Free 12-point SaaS launch checklist: https://mshafei721.github.io/twelvecheck/saas-launch-checklist.html
- Illustrative sample proof pack: https://mshafei721.github.io/twelvecheck/twelvecheck-sample-proof-pack.html

The sample is fictional and demonstrates the deliverable format. It is not a customer result.
